42:      *

43: 44: /** 45: * Implements PDAG/PAG IDA with **incremental FCI propagation** after each local orientation at X. 46: * 47: *

Key differences vs your previous version:

48: *
    49: *
  • After each single-edge refinement at X (replacing a circle at X by tail/arrow), we immediately run 50: * the final FCI orientation rules and prune if the result no longer refines the base PAG/PDAG.
    • 51: *
  • We re-compute the set of orientable (circle-at-X) edges after each propagation so the search shrinks as 52: * implications fire.
    • 53: *
  • Amenability is checked only at the leaf (when no more circles at X remain). For amenability we do **not** 54: * pass any forced-visibility nodes; we reserve that option only for RA set generation.
    • 55: *
